D 78-2
"National Herald" published the following article on February 28 2 37:-

THE WHITE RUSSIANS IN SHANGHAI.

There are about 6,676 employed male White Russians and
1,484 employed female White Russians in Shanghai. Nearly all the female
Russians live on their personal attractions. According to an investigation
made by a certain organisation, the occupations of the female Russians may
be classified as follows:-

Massage girls....................200
Dancing hostesses...............150
Cabaret waitresses..............135
Waitresses....................... 75
Shop employees..................260
Typists and clerks..............190
Actresses.......................120

The rest are mostly "street angels". According to an inve-
stigation made at the end of 1936, there are 7,949 unemployed White Rus-
sians in Shanghai.

The White Russians like to enjoy themselves. Even a beggar
would go to a cabaret at Christmas time to find enjoyment with his savings
of a year.

Very few women marry. The main reason for this is that the
males have not the necessary earning power. Only 84 out of 125 children
(or about 70%) born to White Russians reach maturity. The climate and cir-
cumstances in Shanghai are also factors in the low birth rate. Consequent-
ly, the number of White Russians in Shanghai is decreasing every year.

J.B. 26/2

D 78-2
《国民导报》于1937年2月28日刊登了以下文章：

上海的白俄。

上海约有6,676名有职业的男性白俄和1,484名有职业的女性白俄。几乎所有的女性白俄都靠姿色谋生。据某机构调查，女性白俄的职业可分类如下：

按摩女 ____ 200
舞女 ____ 150
歌舞厅女侍 ____ 135
女侍者 ____ 75
店员 ____ 260
打字员及文员 ____ 190
女演员 ____ 120

其余多为“街头天使”（即妓女）。据1936年底的一项调查，上海有7,949名失业白俄。

白俄生性喜好享乐。即便是乞丐，也会在圣诞节时拿出积攒一年的钱去歌舞厅寻欢作乐。

女性结婚者寥寥无几。主要原因是男性缺乏必要的养家能力。在白俄所生的125名儿童中，仅有84名（约占70%）能长大成人。上海的气候与环境也是导致出生率低的因素。因此，上海的白俄人数逐年减少。
